ultrasound.nameEn: USG of Whole Abdomen (With Pelvic Organs)

findings.liver: Normal in size (approx. 13.5 cm), regular contour and homogeneous parenchymal echotexture. No focal lesion, cyst, or IHBR dilatation noted. Portal vein caliber is normal (10 mm).
findings.gallBladder: Well distended, wall thickness is within normal physiological limits (< 3 mm). Lumen is clear without calculus, sludge, or polyps.
findings.biliaryTree: Common Bile Duct (CBD) is normal in caliber (4.2 mm). No luminal mass or calculus detected.
findings.pancreas: Normal in size, outline, and homogeneous echotexture. Main pancreatic duct is not dilated.
findings.spleen: Normal in size (measuring 9.6 cm), uniform echotexture. Splenic vein is normal at hilum.
findings.kidneys: Both kidneys are normal in size, shape, and anatomical position. Right kidney measures ~10.2 cm, Left kidney measures ~10.6 cm. Corticomedullary differentiation is well-preserved. No calculus, hydronephrosis, or space-occupying lesion is seen on either side.
findings.urinaryBladder: Adequately distended with physiological urine. Bladder walls are smooth and regular in contour (< 3 mm). Lumen is free from stone, mass, or intravesical diverticulum.
findings.prostateOrUterus:
For Males: Prostate gland is normal in size and homogeneous in echogenicity (~18 cc), normal capsule. Post-void residue (PVR) is insignificant (< 15 mL).
For Females: Uterus is anteverted, measuring 7.5 x 4.2 x 3.6 cm. Regular myometrial echotexture, clear regular endometrial stripe (7 mm). Bilateral ovaries are normal with normal follicles. No mass in POD.
findings.peritonealCavity: No free fluid (ascites) or significant lymphadenopathy in peritoneal or pelvic cavity.

ultrasound.impression: ULTRASONOGRAPHY OF WHOLE ABDOMEN REVEALS NORMAL SCAN. No sonologically detectable organomegaly, calculus, mass, or free fluid detected in abdominal and pelvic cavities.
ultrasound.recommendation: Clinical correlation recommended. Repeat scan if symptoms evolve.

ultrasound.nameEn: USG of Pregnancy Profile (Obstetric / Fetal Well-being)
ultrasound.nameBn: প্রেগন্যান্সি প্রোফাইল ও গর্ভস্থ শিশুর স্বাস্থ্য পরীক্ষা

findings.presentation: Single live intrauterine pregnancy in Cephalic / Longitudinal presentation.
findings.cardiacActivity: Active fetal cardiac pulsation noted with regular rhythm. Fetal Heart Rate (FHR): 146 beats per minute (Normal: 120-160 bpm).
findings.fetalMovement: Good active fetal somatic and limb movements appreciated during the scan.
findings.biometry:
Biparietal Diameter (BPD): ~56 mm
Head Circumference (HC): ~205 mm
Abdominal Circumference (AC): ~194 mm
Femur Length (FL): ~42 mm
Estimated Fetal Weight (EFW): ~620 ± 80 grams.
findings.gestationalAge: Composite sonographic gestational age corresponds to ~23 Weeks 4 Days ± 1 Week.
findings.placenta: Placenta is situated anteriorly / fundal, Grade-I maturity. Clear of internal os (No placenta previa).
findings.amnioticFluid: Amniotic fluid volume is adequate. Single deepest vertical pocket (DVP) is 4.8 cm. Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) is ~13.5 cm (Normal range: 8-18 cm).
findings.cervix: Internal os is closed. Cervical canal length is adequate (~36 mm). No funneling.

ultrasound.impression: SINGLE LIVE INTRAUTERINE PREGNANCY OF APPROXIMATELY 23-24 WEEKS GESTATION. Normal fetal growth parameters, satisfactory liquor volume, and normal anterior placenta.
ultrasound.recommendation: Routine antenatal follow-up and clinical correlation with Last Menstrual Period (LMP).

findings.kidneys: Both kidneys are normal in size, shape, and cortical thickness. Right kidney: 10.4 cm, Left kidney: 10.8 cm. Clear central echo complex with intact corticomedullary boundary. No calculus, hydronephrosis, or cyst noted.
findings.ureters: Visualized proximal and distal ureters are not dilated.
findings.urinaryBladder: Well-distended with anechoic urine. Normal smooth bladder wall thickness (~2.5 mm). No radiopaque shadow or intraluminal growth.
findings.prostate: Prostate gland is symmetrically enlarged / normal, measuring approx. 4.2 x 3.6 x 3.2 cm with calculated weight of ~24 grams. Parenchymal echotexture is homogeneous.
findings.postVoidResidue: Post-voiding residual urine volume is approx. 18 mL (Within normal physiological limits).

ultrasound.impression: NORMAL SONOLOGICAL STUDY OF KUB AND PROSTATE. No obstructive uropathy, nephrolithiasis, or significant post-void urine retention.
ultrasound.recommendation: Correlation with Serum Creatinine and Urine R/M/E.

ultrasound.nameEn: USG of Lower Abdomen / Female Pelvic Organs

findings.uterus: Uterus is anteverted, normal in size, measuring 7.8 x 4.4 x 3.8 cm. Myometrium demonstrates uniform homogeneous echotexture without leiomyoma (fibroid) or adenomyosis.
findings.endometrium: Endometrial stripe is central, distinct, and regular, measuring approx. 8.2 mm in thickness. No intracavitary polyp or collection.
findings.cervix: Cervix appears normal in length and echo pattern. No Nabothian cyst or mass.
findings.ovaries: Right Ovary measures 3.1 x 2.0 cm. Left Ovary measures 3.0 x 1.9 cm. Both ovaries exhibit normal physiological stroma and follicular development. No solid or cystic mass detected.
findings.pod: Pouch of Douglas (cul-de-sac) is free from fluid collection or mass.

ultrasound.impression: NORMAL PELVIC ULTRASONOGRAM. Normal anteverted uterus and bilateral ovaries without focal lesion.
ultrasound.recommendation: Clinical correlation with phase of menstrual cycle.

findings.breastTissue: Bilateral breasts demonstrate normal fibro-fatty and glandular parenchymal distribution for age. Cooper's ligaments are intact.
findings.ductalSystem: Major subareolar lactiferous ducts are non-dilated with normal branching architecture.
findings.focalLesions: No discrete solid mass, cystic lesion, ductal ectasia, or architectural distortion seen in either breast.
findings.skinAndNipple: Skin thickness is normal, nipple-areolar complexes are symmetric without retraction or retro-areolar thickening.
findings.axilla: Bilateral axillary regions show no suspicious lymphadenopathy (Morphologically normal fatty hilum preserved).

ultrasound.impression: NORMAL BILATERAL BREAST ULTRASONOGRAPHY. BI-RADS Category 1 (Negative / Normal).
ultrasound.recommendation: Routine clinical breast self-examination and periodic screening.

ultrasound.nameEn: USG of Thyroid Gland & Soft Tissues of Neck

findings.rightLobe: Right lobe measures approx. 4.3 x 1.6 x 1.4 cm. Normal homogeneous echotexture.
findings.leftLobe: Left lobe measures approx. 4.1 x 1.5 x 1.3 cm. Uniform parenchymal echotexture.
findings.isthmus: Isthmus is midline, measuring approx. 2.8 mm in anteroposterior diameter.
findings.nodules: No solid, cystic, or mixed nodule, calcification, or hypervascularity noted on Color Doppler interrogation.
findings.cervicalNodes: No pathological cervical lymphadenopathy along the internal jugular chain.

ultrasound.impression: NORMAL SONOGRAPHIC APPEARANCE OF THYROID GLAND. EU-TIRADS 1 (Normal Thyroid).

xray.nameBn: ডিজিটাল এক্স-রে চেস্ট (বুকের এক্স-রে পি/এ ভিউ)

findings.lungFields: Both lung fields are clear. No evidence of active pulmonary parenchymal infiltration, consolidation, collapse, cavitation, or nodular opacity.
findings.cardiothoracicRatio: Cardiothoracic (CTR) ratio is within normal physiological limits (< 50%). Normal cardiac contour and aortic knuckle.
findings.costophrenicAngles: Bilateral costophrenic and cardiophrenic angles are sharp, deep, and clear. No pleural effusion or thickening.
findings.hilarShadows: Both hilar vascular shadows are normal in size, density, and position.
findings.mediastinumAndTrachea: Mediastinum is central and within normal limits. Trachea is central with normal caliber.
findings.diaphragms: Both diaphragmatic domes are smooth, convex, and normal in position. Subdiaphragmatic regions are clear (No free gas under diaphragm).
findings.bonyThorax: Ribs, clavicles, sternum, and visible dorsal spine appear structurally intact with normal bone mineralization.

xray.impression: NORMAL DIGITAL CHEST PA RADIOGRAPH. No active cardiopulmonary pathology detected.

xray.nameEn: Digital X-Ray Lumbar / Lumbosacral Spine (A/P & Lateral B/V)
xray.nameBn: কোমর ও লাম্বার স্পাইন ডিজিটাল এক্স-রে

findings.curvature: Normal physiological lumbar lordosis is well-maintained.
findings.vertebralBodies: Vertebral body heights, alignment, and cortical margins of L1 through L5 and S1 are intact. No compression fracture or bone destruction.
findings.discSpaces: Intervertebral disc spaces (including L4-L5 and L5-S1) appear well-preserved.
findings.pedicles: Pedicles, transverse processes, and spinous processes appear intact without lysis.
findings.alignment: No spondylolisthesis (anterior or posterior displacement) or step deformity.
findings.sacroiliacJoints: Visualized bilateral sacroiliac joints are clear and symmetric.

xray.impression: NORMAL RADIOLOGICAL STUDY OF LUMBOSACRAL SPINE. No evidence of spondylolisthesis, significant spondylosis, or acute bony injury.
xray.recommendation: Correlate with clinical lower back examination.

xray.nameEn: Digital X-Ray Cervical Spine (A/P & Lateral Views)

findings.lordosis: Normal gentle cervical lordosis is preserved without spasm-induced straightening.
findings.vertebrae: Vertebral bodies from C1 to C7 are intact with normal height, contours, and bone density.
findings.intervertebralDiscs: Intervertebral disc spaces are adequate throughout the cervical spine.
findings.neuralForamina: Visualized neural exit foramina and facet joints are unremarkable.
findings.prevertebralSoftTissue: Prevertebral soft tissue shadow is within normal physiological limits.

xray.impression: NORMAL CERVICAL SPINE RADIOGRAPH. No evidence of cervical spondylosis, disc space narrowing, or fracture.
xray.recommendation: Physiotherapy and clinical correlation if radiculopathy symptoms persist.

xray.nameEn: Digital X-Ray Abdomen Erect View (Including Domes)

findings.gasPattern: Normal distribution of bowel gas within stomach, small and large intestine. No abnormal bowel dilatation.
findings.fluidLevels: No multiple or stepped air-fluid levels identified.
findings.freeAir: No evidence of free air / gas under bilateral diaphragmatic domes (Pneumoperitoneum excluded).
findings.calcifications: No pathological radio-opaque calculus or abnormal calcification noted.
findings.psoasShadows: Psoas muscle margins are symmetric and clearly delineated.

xray.impression: NORMAL ERECT ABDOMINAL RADIOGRAPH. No radiological evidence of bowel obstruction, perforation, or acute surgical abdomen.
xray.recommendation: Correlate clinically and follow up with abdominal ultrasound if pain continues.

xray.nameEn: Digital X-Ray Both Knee Joints Standing A/P & Lateral

findings.jointSpace: Medial and lateral tibiofemoral joint spaces are symmetric and well-preserved bilaterally under weight-bearing view.
findings.patellofemoral: Patellofemoral articulation is normal without lateral subluxation.
findings.articularMargins: Smooth articular cortical surfaces. No subchondral sclerosis, subchondral cysts, or osteophytes.
findings.softTissues: Periarticular soft tissues are unremarkable without joint effusion or calcification.

xray.impression: NORMAL BILATERAL KNEE JOINT RADIOGRAPH. No signs of osteoarthritis or acute traumatic osseous injury.
